changelog: Second non-canonical ancient MVP preview. Expands the published slice from 11 to 31 reviewed territorial-practice claims, incorporates ancient expansion batches 01–03, and replaces the older Mauryan disputed treatment with the reviewed P2 synthesis. Deferred/weak candidates and external-participation-only evidence are not promoted into territorial P-level layers. The canonical v0.6.1 data release is unchanged.
qc_summary: 31/31 selected territorial-practice claims are reviewed; 31/31 have claim-specific source evidence; every selected territorial target has reviewed geometry coverage or an explicit reviewed unresolved-geometry record; the release preserves publication/research separation and does not infer absence from missing geometry.
unresolved_issues: Several accepted research cases intentionally retain unresolved historical geometry, including multi-polity South Arabia, Punic Carthage, Aksum, Late Period Egypt, Sasanian Iran, Bactria, Sogdiana, Pre-Angkor Cambodia, and other previously unresolved targets. These claims remain visible in the MVP evidence list without a false territorial fill until provenance-backed historical geometry is resolved. Opone external-participation evidence and deferred candidates such as Kush/Meroe, Garamantes, Rhapta/Azania, and Gupta-period northern India are excluded from the territorial release. This preview is non-canonical.
